weather.note: 十月初台南／台北型態接近：多雲到晴、午後短暫陣雨機率低，日夜溫差約 6 度。★ 這一欄沒有接中央氣象署 API，數字是依十月初常態推估的「參考值」，不是即時觀測——要真實數字請直接看氣象署 App。　【今天唯一和天氣有關的安排】今天是週日、行事曆只有兩件家事（倒垃圾、刷廁所），兩件都在室內或樓下幾分鐘就結束，天氣不構成變數。倒是明天 10/05（一）日文（三）開始上聽力，出門前要多帶一本書，書包重量比天氣值得注意。

schedule.note: ✅ Notion 連接器正常：「事件」資料庫（0c43c2d0-cb80-4f89-86fe-14e5ae8bffb7）今天 10/4（日）共兩筆——倒垃圾、刷廁所，都是家事、優先度低、狀態「未開始」。　【這張表今天的真實樣貌】往前後各抓一週可以看得很清楚：10/01 洗衣服、10/02 倒垃圾、10/03 洗衣服、10/04 倒垃圾＋刷廁所、10/05 洗衣服、10/06 倒垃圾、10/07 刷廁所……整張表從 10/1 到 10/12 **只有家事三件事在輪**，沒有任何一筆功課、報告、考試、補教或特殊課。　【所以今天的重點不在這一區，而在下面那一區】行事曆是空的，不代表這週沒事——它代表「學校的事還沒被你輸入進來」。明天（10/05，週一）日文（三）就要帶聽力＋文法兩本書上課，這件事現在只存在於 Moodle 公告和下面的信件區，不在這張表裡。下面那封信旁邊有「加入行事曆」按鈕，按一下就補上了，大約 10 秒。　【一句話】今天的 Notion 很乾淨，但乾淨的原因是它還沒被餵資料，不是你真的沒事。

items.title: 🚨 明天 10/05（一）日文（三）開始上聽力——聽力課本＋文法課本「兩本都要帶」，而這件事不在你的 Notion 裡
items.kind: 需要動作：今晚就把兩本書放進書包（約 1 分鐘）＋ 按右邊按鈕補進行事曆（約 10 秒）
items.detail: ★ 原文重點：「下週開始課堂上會來練習日文聽力，所以請各位同學接下來每週上課時**聽力和文法的書都要帶來**！期中考及期末考也會有聽力測驗題型。」助教另外加了一句很容易被誤讀的括號：「（週一班因為課程進度較慢的關係，10/05 的上課會不會用到還不一定，但還是請同學帶來！）」　【這句括號是陷阱，不是免責】它說的是「明天可能用不到」，不是「明天可以不帶」。而且它只對明天有效——從明天起這就是**每週常態**，不是一次性的事。所以正確的處理方式不是「明天帶一次」，而是「把聽力課本固定放進週一的書包」。　【第二件事，比帶書更重要】原文還有一句：「聽力課本如果還沒買的話請盡快購買，不知道哪一本的話可以參考課程說明 PPT。」如果你手上還沒有那本聽力課本，那今天（週日）就是你唯一能處理的時間——明天上課前書店不一定來得及。先去 Moodle 把課程說明 PPT 打開、確認書名，這一步 2 分鐘，但跳過它的代價是整學期每週都缺一本書。　【為什麼標紅】這封信有三個同時成立的條件：①明天就生效 ②會持續整學期 ③牽涉到期中期末的題型（聽力測驗）。任何一個單獨出現都還好，三個疊在一起就是今天最該處理的事。　【今天的最短路徑，約 3 分鐘】1) 開 Moodle 課程說明 PPT，確認聽力課本書名；2) 手上有書→直接放進書包；沒有→今天下單或記下明天去書店；3) 按下面的「加入行事曆」，把「日文（三）帶聽力＋文法課本」寫進 10/05。

items.title: 📗 會計學公佈欄：「Google Sheets 完全指南」教學連結（無截止日、無作業，純資源）
items.kind: 不需要動作：收進書籤即可，不必今天讀
items.detail: ★ 內容就是一個連結：https://mictu.vercel.app/google-sheets-tutorial ，沒有附帶作業、沒有繳交期限、公佈欄原文也沒有說會考。　【為什麼仍然值得留著】會計學作業後期多半會要求用試算表做分錄與報表；而你本來就在做加密貨幣與個股的觀察清單，Sheets 的函數（VLOOKUP／QUERY／IMPORTHTML／ARRAYFORMULA）對那邊的幫助可能比對會計學還大。　【建議的處理方式】今天不要讀。把它丟進書籤，等第一份要用到試算表的會計學作業出現時再回頭翻——那時候帶著具體問題去看教學，吸收率會高很多。現在讀它只會變成「今天好像有學東西」的錯覺。

mail.footnote: ★★★ 今天這一區的一句話總結：**只有一件事需要你動，而且它的截止時間是明天早上出門前**——日文（三）的聽力課本＋文法課本。　【為什麼這件小事值得放在紅色】因為它的成本結構很不對稱：今天花 3 分鐘處理（確認書名、放進書包、補進行事曆），代價是 3 分鐘；明天早上才想起來，代價是整堂課沒有課本、而且這是整學期每週都會重複的課。　【另外一個觀察，關於你的系統本身】連續兩天的狀況一樣：**真正要做的事都出現在 Moodle，而不是出現在 Notion**。你的行事曆從 10/1 到 10/12 只有家事在輪，但學校的事一件都沒進去。這不是 Notion 壞了，是中間少了一個「把 Moodle 公告轉成行事曆」的動作——而晨報裡的「加入行事曆」按鈕就是為了補這一段。今天只要按一次，就算這個流程開始運作了。

items.en: US September Payrolls Collapse to 29,000 as Unemployment Ticks Up to 4.2%, Gutting Odds of an October Fed Hike
items.zh: 美國九月非農只增 2.9 萬人、失業率升到 4.2%，十月升息機率一夜從 64% 掉到 16%——這是這份晨報裡所有市場數字背後的那條線
items.summary: The September employment report released Friday showed nonfarm payrolls rising just 29,000, far below the 90,000 consensus and down from a revised 133,000 in August. Unemployment edged up to 4.2% from 4.1%, and average hourly earnings rose only 0.1% on the month and 3% on the year. Traders read the combination of weak hiring and cooling wages as removing the case for further tightening: market-implied odds of an October Federal Reserve rate increase fell from roughly 64% to about 16% within hours. Treasury yields dropped and equities rallied into the close.

items.en: Flydubai Captain Describes Subduing Copilot in Cockpit Attack as Israel Admits It Held No Prior Intelligence
items.zh: flydubai 劫機案後續：機長詳述如何在駕駛艙制伏副機師，以色列承認事前完全沒有情資
items.summary: Captain Smit Machchhar gave Prime Minister Netanyahu a detailed account of how he overpowered copilot Hamam al-Hammami during the attempted cockpit attack, saying he "had one last fight left in me." Security reviews published Saturday showed al-Hammami had flown the Dubai to Tel Aviv route several times before, and that Israeli services held no prior intelligence on him. The reviews also found that pilots holding Iranian, Syrian and Iraqi nationality have entered Israeli airspace using dual passports, raising questions about aircrew vetting for inbound carriers.

items.en: Eisenkot Ties Netanyahu's Refusal of an October 7 State Inquiry to the Aviation Security Failure
items.zh: 反對黨領袖艾森科特把「拒絕成立十月七日國家調查委員會」和這次航安破口連在一起，政治壓力升高
items.summary: Opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot argued Saturday that the government's continued refusal to establish a state commission of inquiry into the October 7 attacks is directly connected to the aviation security lapse exposed by the flydubai incident, saying unexamined institutional failures repeat themselves. The remarks sharpened an already tense coalition debate: right-wing politician Ofer Winter said he would demand ultra-Orthodox conscription yet still join a Netanyahu-led government, while Democrats chairman Yair Golan called for bringing the Arab Ra'am party into a future coalition, drawing immediate criticism.

items.en: IDF Says It Struck Senior Hamas Official Ali al-Amoudi in Gaza City
items.zh: 以色列國防軍證實在加薩市空襲擊中哈瑪斯高層 al-Amoudi，巴方通報五人死亡
items.summary: The Israel Defense Forces confirmed on Saturday that it had carried out a strike in Gaza City targeting Ali al-Amoudi, described as a senior Hamas official. Palestinian sources reported five deaths from the strike. The operation came on a day that also saw settlers filmed attempting to force entry into a Palestinian family home near Nablus, an incident that drew condemnation inside Israel. Both events add to the pressure on an already fragile security situation and complicate the diplomatic track that regional mediators have been attempting to restart.

items.en: Houthis Claim Missile and Drone Attack on an Aramco Facility in Riyadh
items.zh: 葉門青年運動宣稱以飛彈與無人機攻擊利雅德的 Aramco 設施——這是能源價格的尾部風險，不是今天的事
items.summary: Yemen's Houthi movement said on Saturday that it had launched missiles and drones at a Saudi Aramco facility in Riyadh. Saudi authorities had not confirmed damage at the time of reporting, and oil markets had already closed for the week, so any price reaction will not appear until Monday's open. The claim matters less for its immediate effect than for what it signals: strikes on Saudi energy infrastructure have historically been the fastest route from a regional security headline to a global crude price move.

items.en: Google Launches Gemini 4 Argon, Its Return to the Frontier, First to Vetted Cyber Defenders
items.zh: Google 推出 Gemini 4 Argon，先開放給資安防禦者；輸出上限從 6.4 萬 token 跳到 100 萬
items.summary: Google announced Gemini 4 Argon, its new frontier model, rolling it out first to vetted cyber defenders through the Fairwind Program before broader access for paid API customers and AI Ultra subscribers. Google reports 77.9% on DeepSWE v1.1 for software engineering, first place at 51.3% on Zapier's AutomationBench, and a tie for first at 68% on CWE-bench v1 for security remediation. The headline architectural change is a one-million-token output limit, up from 64,000. Introductory pricing is two dollars per million input tokens and ten dollars per million output tokens.

items.en: Anthropic Commits $100 Million to Train 10,000 Engineers Through a Claude Frontier Academy
items.zh: Anthropic 投入一億美元、要訓練一萬名工程師把 Claude 導入大型企業——缺的不是模型，是會裝的人
items.summary: Anthropic said on October 2 that it will spend one hundred million dollars on a programme called Claude Frontier Academy, training ten thousand engineers to deploy Claude inside large enterprises. The company framed the spend as a response to an implementation bottleneck rather than a capability one: enterprises that have bought access often lack staff who can integrate models into existing systems. The announcement followed a week in which Barclays expanded its Claude deployment across operations and client experience, and came days after the release of Claude Sonnet 5.5.

items.en: Storage Stocks Crater as Western Digital and Seagate Both Fall More Than 10% in a Single Session
items.zh: 硬碟雙雄單日同時重挫逾 10%：在一個大盤普漲的日子裡逆勢崩跌，訊號比數字重要
items.summary: Western Digital fell 10.22% and Seagate Technology dropped 10.21% on Friday, with Ultra Clean Holdings down 7.57% and GDS Holdings down 7.48%. The declines are notable because they happened on a broadly positive day, with the Nasdaq Composite up 1.19%. Analysts attributed the move to competitive pressure within storage and data centre supply chains rather than to macro factors. For anyone tracking AI infrastructure, the split is the signal: compute and networking names rallied while the storage layer sold off hard.

items.en: Rays Shut Out Yankees 1-0 in ALDS Game 1 as Rasmussen Carries a No-Hitter Into the Eighth
items.zh: 美聯分區賽首戰：光芒 1:0 完封洋基，Rasmussen 無安打壓制到第八局
items.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays opened the American League Division Series with a 1-0 win over the New York Yankees on Friday, taking a 1-0 series lead. Starter Drew Rasmussen carried a no-hitter into the eighth inning before it was broken up, in what was the standout individual performance of the opening postseason day. The single run was enough in a game defined by pitching on both sides, and it hands Tampa Bay home-field momentum in a series many had expected the Yankees to control.

items.en: White Sox Blank Guardians 3-0 to Take Game 1 of the Other American League Division Series
items.zh: 白襪 3:0 完封守護者，美聯另一組分區賽同樣由客隊先下一城
items.summary: The Chicago White Sox shut out the Cleveland Guardians 3-0 on Friday to lead their American League Division Series 1-0. Combined with Tampa Bay's win over New York, both American League openers ended in shutouts, an unusual statistical outcome for a single postseason day and a reminder of how much October baseball turns on starting pitching. Cleveland now faces the familiar problem of needing to win on the road later in the series after dropping the opener at home.

items.en: Dodgers Beat Braves 5-3 and Brewers Edge Padres 3-2 as All Four Division Series Openers Go to the Visitors
items.zh: 國聯道奇 5:3 勇士、釀酒人 3:2 教士——四組分區賽首戰全由同一側拿下，系列賽全部 1-0
items.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers defeated the Atlanta Braves 5-3 and the Milwaukee Brewers edged the San Diego Padres 3-2 on Friday, completing a clean sweep of Game 1 results across all four Division Series. Every series now stands at 1-0. The National League games were the higher-scoring half of the day, in contrast to the two American League shutouts, but the pattern held: in all four matchups the team that won the opener did so in a one-score or two-score game rather than a blowout.

items.en: Nature Human Behaviour: Opening a Social Media Account in Sixth Grade Measurably Lowers Test Scores Through Grade Ten
items.zh: 5,227 名學生的縱貫研究：六年級就開社群帳號的人，八年級數學與母語成績顯著較低，而且差距到十年級還在擴大
items.summary: A longitudinal study of 5,227 northern Italian students from the 2007 and 2008 birth cohorts found that those who opened social media accounts in sixth grade scored about 0.22 standard deviations lower in Italian and 0.18 lower in mathematics by eighth grade than peers who waited until ninth grade or later. The gap widened to 0.27 in mathematics by grade ten. Using a difference-in-differences design on INVALSI standardised tests, the authors found smartphone pervasiveness, checking devices during homework, sleep and school, explained 33 to 47 percent of the mathematics effect. English scores were unaffected.

items.en: Meta-Analysis Finds Educational Interventions Reliably Improve Students' Ethical and Moral Outcomes
items.zh: 系統性回顧與統合分析：道德與倫理教育課程是真的有效，不是只有感覺有效
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis published in Nature Human Behaviour concludes that educational interventions produce measurable improvements in students' ethical and moral outcomes across the studies examined. The result is methodologically interesting because moral education has long been criticised as resistant to measurement, with critics arguing that self-reported attitude change after a course says little about behaviour. By pooling effects across a large set of trials, the authors argue the effect survives aggregation rather than depending on any single favourable study design.

items.en: Oxford Blavatnik School Flags a Persistent Gap Between Education Policy and Classroom Practice
items.zh: 牛津 Blavatnik 學院：教育政策與現場實作之間的落差仍然很大——研究結論進不了教室
items.summary: Researchers at the University of Oxford's Blavatnik School of Government highlighted a Nature Human Behaviour article documenting the continuing gap between what education policy specifies and what actually happens in classrooms. The core problem the authors identify is not a shortage of evidence about effective teaching but the absence of reliable mechanisms for translating that evidence into daily practice at scale. The finding is relevant to any reform programme that assumes publishing guidance is sufficient to change behaviour inside schools.

items.en: Independent Benchmarks Put Gemini 4 Argon Level With GPT-6 Astra but Behind Claude Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5
items.zh: 第三方評測：Argon 智能指數 53，追平 GPT-6 Astra，但仍落後 Claude Opus 5.5（58）與 Sonnet 5.5（56）；幻覺率 15% 對 51% 是真正的差距
items.summary: Artificial Analysis scored Gemini 4 Argon at 53 on its Intelligence Index, matching OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra and trailing Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5 at 58 and Sonnet 5.5 at 56. The more striking number is hallucination rate, where Argon measured 15 percent against 51 percent for GPT-6 Astra. Pricing starts at two dollars per million input tokens rising to four, with a 95 percent discount on cached inputs, though reviewers noted Argon consumes more tokens per task, which can erase the apparent cost advantage.

items.en: Taiwan Rally Rotates Into Passive Components, ABF Substrates, Silicon Photonics and CPO as TSMC Slips
items.zh: 台股 10/2 輪動很清楚：被動元件、ABF 載板、矽光子、CPO 多檔攻漲停，台積電反而小跌 0.4%
items.summary: The Taiwan weighted index closed Friday at 48,475.74, up 122.25 points or 0.25%, on turnover of 898.2 billion New Taiwan dollars. TSMC fell 10 points to 2,500, a 0.4% decline, yet the index still rose, because money rotated into passive components, ABF substrates, silicon photonics and co-packaged optics, several of which hit daily limits. Fubon Investment Consulting noted that falling volume near the record intraday high of 48,601 suggests thinning momentum and recommended holding roughly 60% exposure rather than adding on strength.

items.en: Quantum Computing Names Down About 30% in a Month Even as Commercial Narrative Strengthens
items.zh: 量子股一個月跌約三成：IonQ、Rigetti、D-Wave 同步修正——故事沒變，估值先變了
items.summary: IonQ, Rigetti Computing and D-Wave Quantum have each fallen roughly 30% over the past month, a drawdown that arrived while the sector's commercial narrative was, if anything, getting stronger. Coverage published this week continues to frame the group as early-stage bets on quantum moving from research to commercial deployment. The divergence between story and price is the useful observation here: in pre-revenue sectors, sentiment and rate expectations set the price far more than operational progress does, and a 30% monthly move tells you about positioning, not physics.

items.en: Fujii Kaze Adds Kaohsiung National Stadium to the Prema World Tour on 31 October 2026
items.zh: 🇹🇼 藤井風（ふじい かぜ）世巡加場：10/31 高雄國家體育場——距今不到四週，這是清單裡唯一有台灣確定日期、而且就在本月的一場
items.summary: Fujii Kaze has added Kaohsiung National Stadium on 31 October 2026 to his Prema World Tour, alongside Bangkok's Supachalasai National Stadium on 26 December and Seoul's Gocheok Sky Dome on 9 January 2027. The previously discussed Hong Kong show has been cancelled. The tour supports his third album Prema, released in September 2025 and performed entirely in English, and extends into summer 2027 with European and North American legs. Japan-date lottery applications ran from 24 April to 6 May 2026.

items.en: LiSA's 15th Anniversary Asia Tour Confirms Taipei Arena on 19-20 June and AsiaWorld-Arena Hong Kong on 18 July
items.zh: 🇹🇼🇭🇰 LiSA 十五週年亞巡：台北小巨蛋 6/19–20、香港亞洲國際博覽館 7/18，專輯《LACE UP》4/15 發行
items.summary: LiSA's seventh studio album LACE UP arrived on 15 April 2026 with fifteen tracks including REALiZE, HELLO WORLD and ReawakeR, a collaboration with Felix of Stray Kids. The Japan arena leg, LiVE is Smile Always 15, ran across Tokyo, Hyogo and Aichi in April and May. The Asia leg confirms Taipei Arena on 19 and 20 June, AsiaWorld-Arena in Hong Kong on 18 July, and Seoul's Olympic Hall on 1 and 2 August, with further Asian dates still to be announced.

items.en: YOASOBI Announce a Ten-City Asia Dome and Stadium Tour for 2026-27 Including Taipei and Hong Kong
items.zh: 🇹🇼🇭🇰 YOASOBI 宣布十城亞洲巨蛋暨體育場巡演，台北、香港都在名單上，但日期尚未公布
items.summary: YOASOBI announced the YOASOBI ASIA 10-CITY DOME AND STADIUM TOUR 2026-2027 at the final show of their hall tour in Okinawa. Confirmed cities are Osaka, Nagoya, Fukuoka, Sapporo and Tokyo in Japan, plus Taipei, Seoul, Hong Kong and Singapore, with one further city still unannounced. No specific dates, venues or ticketing details have been released yet, and the organisers say more information is coming. For Taiwan and Hong Kong fans this is a watch item rather than an actionable one.

items.en: Mrs. GREEN APPLE Release Sixth Album POPS and Announce a 28-Date Arena Tour Across Thirteen Japanese Cities
items.zh: Mrs. GREEN APPLE 第六張專輯《POPS》9/30 發行，三年來首度全國巡迴 13 城 28 場；亞洲目前只有直播與影院放映
items.summary: Mrs. GREEN APPLE released POPS on 30 September 2026 through EMI Records and Universal Music Japan, the defining album of the band's Phase 3. It collects previously issued singles including GOOD DAY, Wind and Town, Carrying Happiness, Summer Shadow and lulu, the opening theme for the anime Frieren Beyond World's End, plus Brand New, the Japanese theme for Marvel's Spider-Man Brand New Day. The accompanying arena tour runs 28 shows across thirteen Japanese cities. Asia access so far is limited to livestreams and cinema screenings in Taiwan, Hong Kong, Korea and Thailand.

market.highlight: ★★★ 今天只要記住一件事：**九月非農就業只增加 29,000 人（市場預期 90,000）**，而市場對這個壞消息的反應是——漲。　【這不是矛盾，是利率在主導一切】失業率從 4.1% 升到 4.2%、平均時薪月增只有 0.1%、年增 3%。對實體經濟，這是「招聘在熄火」；但對股市，這是「聯準會沒有理由再升息了」。數字公布後，十月升息機率從約 64% 直接掉到 16%，公債殖利率下滑，三大指數同步收紅：道瓊 +0.49%、S&P 500 +0.73%、那斯達克 +1.19%。　【這個框架可以幫你讀懂接下來好幾週的盤】當市場處在「利率驅動」的階段，壞的經濟數據＝好的股價，直到壞到讓人開始擔心衰退為止。那個轉折點通常出現在失業率連續快速上升、或企業財報開始下修的時候。現在還沒到，但 4.1% → 4.2% 是第一個刻度，值得你記下來，往後每個月對照一次。　【對你的觀察清單的實際意義】降息預期上升，對高估值成長股（量子、太空、加密、未獲利科技）的幫助理論上最大——但看 10/2 的實際結果，漲的是半導體類比與被動元件（MXL +15%、IMOS +14.6%、SYNA +14.1%、VSH +11.4%），跌的是儲存（WDC -10.2%、STX -10.2%）。所以利率只是背景，產業輪動才是當天的主因。別把「降息預期」當成萬用解釋。
market.note: ★ 今天三條主線：　①【美股：一個典型的「利率驅動反彈日」】三大指數全紅，那斯達克漲幅 1.19% 最大，合乎「壞數據→降息預期→成長股受惠」的邏輯。NVIDIA 盤中創下 237.87 美元的歷史新高、收漲約 2.5%；Tesla 漲約 4%，因為第三季交車 486,532 輛優於預期。這兩檔都在你的清單裡，是這一天清單內表現最明確的兩檔。　②【台股：指數漲、權值股跌，這是輪動不是背離】加權指數收 48,475.74，漲 122.25 點（+0.25%），成交 8,982 億元。但台積電收 2,500 元、跌 10 元（-0.4%）。指數在權值王下跌的情況下還能漲，代表錢在中小型族群裡——被動元件、ABF 載板、矽光子、CPO 多檔攻上漲停。富邦投顧提醒：量能在逼近 48,601 的歷史盤中高點時反而縮，動能不足，建議持股水位維持六成左右、不要追高加碼。　③【儲存族群逆勢崩跌，這是今天最值得你想一想的一件事】在一個大盤普漲的日子裡，WDC 和 STX 雙雙跌超過 10%，UCTT -7.6%、GDS -7.5%。這四檔都不在你的清單裡，但它們拆解了一個常見的誤解：「AI 基建」不是一個會一起漲的整體。運算（NVDA）、網通、類比晶片在漲，儲存在崩。如果你心裡的分類是「AI 相關 = 一起動」，這一天就是反證。　★★★【這一區今天最大的限制，請務必讀】你的觀察清單共 75 檔，但我今天**只能交叉確認其中 3 檔的 10/02 漲跌幅**（2330、NVDA、TSLA）。其餘 72 檔，我沒有找到可信的單日收盤漲跌幅來源，所以我選擇**留白（顯示灰色「—」）而不是用推估值填滿**。看到一整片灰色不是網頁壞了，是這一天的資料就只到這裡。下面「≥5% 個股」那一區放的是當日全市場的最大變動者（來自 COT Trading 市場異動榜），它們多數不在你的清單內，我已經標明。

movers.name: ⚠️ 先說清楚這一區今天的資料基準
movers.price: 台股＋美股皆為 2026/10/02（五）收盤・當日全市場異動榜
movers.reason: ★ 下面列出的是 10/02 全市場漲跌幅 ≥5% 的主要標的，**其中沒有任何一檔在你的 75 檔觀察清單內**。這不是篩選失誤，是那一天你的清單確實沒有出現 5% 以上的個股變動（已確認的三檔：2330 -0.4%、NVDA +2.5%、TSLA +4.0%，都在 5% 以內）。　【所以這一區今天的用途不是「你的持股怎麼了」，而是「市場今天在幹嘛」】這五漲五跌拼出來的圖像非常清楚：類比晶片與被動元件大漲、儲存與資料中心硬體大跌。同一天、同一個「半導體」標籤底下，兩個方向。

movers.name: MaxLinear（清單外 · 當日最大漲幅）
movers.reason: ★ 類比與混合訊號晶片廠，漲勢出現在第三季財報公布前，屬於「預期驅動」而非「結果驅動」。【判斷框架】財報前的大漲是最難處理的一種：你賺的是別人對財報的猜測，而不是財報本身。如果財報如期亮眼，漲幅通常已經反映完；如果不如預期，回檔會很快。對觀察者而言，值得記住的是**族群訊號**——MXL、SYNA、VSH 同天大漲，說明資金在轉進類比／被動元件，這比單一檔的漲幅更有資訊量。

movers.name: ChipMOS 南茂科技（清單外 · 台廠 ADR）
movers.reason: ★ 台灣封測廠的美國存託憑證。這一檔對你特別值得看一眼，因為它和你清單裡的日月光投控（3711）同屬封測，但 10/02 當天 IMOS 大漲近 15%，而台股封測族群並未出現同等級的表現。【這個落差在說什麼】ADR 與本地股價同步性不完美，時差（美股晚台股一天）＋ 流動性差異會放大波動。看到 ADR 大漲不代表隔天台股同族群一定跟上，但確實值得在 10/05（一）開盤時對照一次。

movers.name: Synaptics（清單外）
movers.reason: ★ 人機介面與觸控／IoT 晶片。和 MXL 同屬類比與邊緣應用陣營，同日同幅度大漲，是前述「資金轉進類比晶片」判斷的第二個證據點。【方法論提醒】單一檔大漲可能是公司特有消息；三檔同性質標的同日同向大漲，才構成族群訊號。這就是為什麼這一區要整組看，不要只挑最大漲幅那一檔。

movers.name: Penguin Solutions（清單外）
movers.reason: ★ 企業級記憶體與 AI 基礎設施解決方案。【這一檔讓今天的圖像變得有趣】它屬於記憶體／基礎設施，卻和暴跌的 WDC、STX 走相反方向。所以「儲存崩跌」這個說法要再精確一點：崩的是**傳統硬碟與大型資料中心硬體**，不是整個記憶體鏈。你清單裡的南亞科（2408）、華邦電（2344）、旺宏（2337）、Micron（MU）屬於 DRAM／NAND／NOR，和 WDC/STX 的 HDD 生意不是同一回事——別被同一天的新聞標題混在一起。

movers.name: Vishay Intertechnology（清單外）
movers.reason: ★ 被動元件（電阻、電容、電感）大廠。【台美對照的最佳例子】同一天，台股的被動元件族群也有多檔攻上漲停（UDN 盤後報導點名華東、臻鼎等）。美股 VSH +11.4%、台股被動元件漲停——這是**同一個產業訊號在兩個市場同時出現**，比任何單一市場的單日漲幅都更值得記住。被動元件的需求通常跟著終端電子出貨走，同步大漲往往反映對下一季拉貨的預期轉強。

movers.name: Western Digital（清單外 · 當日最大跌幅之一）
movers.reason: ★ 硬碟與快閃儲存大廠，在大盤普漲的一天跌超過 10%。【為什麼這件事重要】逆勢重挫比順勢重挫更有資訊量：當大盤、利率、情緒全都站在你這邊，股價還跌 10%，那原因幾乎一定是產業或公司特有的，不是宏觀的。市場歸因是儲存與資料中心供應鏈的競爭壓力。　【對你的實際用處】這提供了一個檢查清單分類的機會：你把 AI 相關標的分成「AI伺服器」「散熱電源」「PCB/CCL」「記憶體」等——10/02 這一天證明這個細分是對的，因為它們當天走勢並不一致。如果你的分類只有一欄「AI」，你就看不到今天這個分歧。

movers.name: Seagate Technology（清單外）
movers.reason: ★ 與 WDC 幾乎完全同步下跌（-10.21% vs -10.22%），這種「兩家競爭對手同日同幅度重挫」的型態，幾乎可以排除單一公司消息，指向**整個次產業的重新定價**。【怎麼用這個觀察】當兩家直接競爭者同向同幅移動，通常是共同的需求端或價格端訊息（例如大客戶砍單、報價下修、或替代技術的消息）。這類事件的影響通常不會一天結束，值得在 10/05 開盤後再看一次它們有沒有延續。

movers.name: Ultra Clean Holdings（清單外）
movers.reason: ★ 半導體設備次系統與潔淨解決方案。和 WDC／STX 同日下跌，但跌幅較小。【位置的意義】UCTT 位在設備端（更上游），它和儲存一起跌，暗示市場修正的可能不只是「硬碟賣不好」，而是對某一段資本支出的預期在降溫。這只是推測，不是結論——但它是個值得追蹤的線索，而追蹤方式很簡單：看它和 WDC/STX 在接下來幾天是不是繼續同向。

movers.name: GDS Holdings（清單外）
movers.reason: ★ 中國資料中心營運商。【把它放進來的原因】它補完了當天下跌組的圖像：硬碟（WDC/STX）＋ 設備（UCTT）＋ 資料中心營運（GDS）一起跌，而運算晶片（NVDA +2.5%）在漲。　【這是今天最乾淨的一個教訓】「AI 基建」這四個字底下，10/02 這一天同時存在 +2.5% 和 -10.2%。所以當你之後讀到任何一句「AI 基建族群今天如何如何」，第一個反應應該是問「哪一層？」——運算層、網通層、儲存層、設備層、營運層，它們在同一天可以完全相反。

movers.name: Maase Inc.（清單外 · 當日最大跌幅）
movers.reason: ★ 當日跌幅榜首。【為什麼只用一句話帶過】這是一檔小型股，單日 13% 的波動在小型股身上並不罕見，而且我沒有找到可靠的歸因來源。列出來是為了讓「≥5% 名單」完整，不是因為它有分析價值。　【順帶一提的方法論】看漲跌幅排行榜時，先確認市值與成交量——小型股的 ±15% 和大型股的 ±15% 是完全不同量級的事件，前者常常只是幾筆大單，後者才是真的有事發生。

market.historyNote: 個股 sparkline 依「當日漲跌幅」與 config/site.json 的參考價重建、僅供示意；縱軸為實際幣別（台股新臺幣、美股美元）。今天只有 3 檔有漲跌幅資料，所以絕大多數卡片會顯示灰色「—」且線條為平線——那是正確的空狀態，不是渲染錯誤。　【參考價校準這件事，今天給一個明確的數字】config/site.json 裡台積電的參考價是 2,390 元，但 10/02 實際收盤是 2,500 元，差距 110 元（約 4.6%）。類似的落差在其他標的上也存在。這不影響漲跌幅的正確性（漲跌幅是獨立的數字），只影響 sparkline 的縱軸刻度好不好看。　【建議的處理方式】不需要每天校準。比較務實的做法是每月一次、挑月初某一天把 site.json 的 75 檔參考價一次更新為當天收盤，這樣 sparkline 的視覺尺度全年都不會偏離太多。下一個自然的時間點就是這個月——如果你願意花十分鐘，10/05（一）收盤後是最乾淨的時機。
